personality: Fusion of 1 (iOS-Native Clean) structure with 3 (Editorial Mobile) typography and color
personality_one_liner: A premium, warm, and tastefully refined internal productivity tool that echoes Indian wedding traditions without sacrificing operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for editorial feel but clean iOS structural alignment for inputs and lists.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar, sticky headers over scrolling content, floating action buttons.
Featured/Hero event cards with translucent text overlay (ensure gradient scrim is used).
dont's: Do not use on input fields, normal list items, or regular cards.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Staff-only secure login with a premium, traditional aesthetic background.

states.error: Bottom sheet or toast showing authentication error.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). A glassmorphic bottom sheet containing the phone/OTP or email/password inputs, and a sticky Login button. Typography uses Playfair Display for 'Mauli Events'.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: At-a-glance view of Today's Events, Quick Stats, and recent notifications.

states.empty: Illustration of an elegant mandap with 'No events today' text.
states.error: Error banner under header with retry button.

screens.layout: iOS-Native layout: Large Playfair Display header 'Today'. Top section: Horizontal scroll of Quick Stats cards (Revenue, Enquiries, Pending Payments). Middle section: Vertical list of Today's Event cards. Event cards feature a subtle brandTertiary tint or a background image of the venue type with a bottom scrim.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Monthly/Weekly/Daily views of confirmed bookings and tentative enquiries.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No bookings on this date'.

screens.layout: Sticky month/week toggle header. A scrollable calendar grid. Selecting a date opens a bottom sheet with a detailed list of events, status chips (e.g., Confirmed, Blocked, Tentative), assigned resources, and event times.

screens.name: CustomerManagement
screens.purpose: List of contacts, with detail views holding history, quotations, and bills.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Add your first customer'.

screens.layout: Search bar with a sticky header. Alphabetically sectioned lists. Clicking a customer opens a detail page (using Playfair Display for the name, Plus Jakarta Sans for details) with tabs for 'Details', 'Bookings', and 'Invoices'. Floating Action Button (glassmorphic) to 'Add Customer'.

screens.name: QuotationsAndInvoices
screens.purpose: Generate and manage quotations, track payments, and share via WhatsApp.
screens.layout: Segmented control (Quotations / Invoices). Kanban or list-style tracking for Pending vs Paid. Detail view includes a prominent 'Share on WhatsApp' button (wa.me link generation) anchored at the bottom using safe-area padding.

screens.name: InventoryAndChecklists
screens.purpose: Track decoration, food raw materials, catering recipes, and worker event checklists.
screens.layout: Two-column grid for inventory categories (Decoration, Food). Clicking into a category shows a clean iOS-style list of items with stock levels. Checklists use large tap targets for checkboxes (44x44pt) with a strikethrough effect upon completion.

login_background.alt: Marigold flower decoration background representing warmth and Indian wedding traditions

empty_state_decor.alt: Elegant wedding decor featuring a lavish floral arrangement

default_venue.alt: Elegant corridor with chandeliers and floral arrangements

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Playfair Display is used only for major headings and large typography, capped at 500 weight. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all body text, lists, inputs, and functional UI.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) on the Login background and any Event image cards to ensure text contrast.
Do not use any blue, indigo, or purple colors. Rely on the maroon (brand) and marigold (brandSecondary) palette. Do not use random hex codes.

For WhatsApp sharing, use wa.me links explicitly generated with prefilled text (e.g. wa.me/919999999999?text=Hello...). Keep the Share button sticky at the bottom of the Invoice/Quotation detail screens.
Always maintain a minimum touch target size of 44x44pt for list items, checkboxes, and buttons.
Apply glassmorphism (via expo-blur or expo-glass-effect) on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to give a premium feel over scrolling content.
Keep forms strict to single-column, labels above inputs. No floating labels.
Role-based UI: Owner sees Revenue/Profit stats, Worker sees assigned Checklists/Events. Filter visibility based on role.

For the calendar grid, avoid overwhelming dot-markers. Use color-coded chips or indicators (Maroon for Blocked/Confirmed, Marigold for Tentative) and show the detailed list in a bottom sheet when a date is selected.
